en: A card-flip table. Twenty-five cards, and the coins grow with every number found. Play?
A card-flip table. Without a Coin Case there is nothing to play with.
Welcome to the Celadon Game Corner! The tables take coins, and coins need a case to carry them in.
text: Bine ai venit la Celadon Game Corner! Mesele iau monede, iar monedele au nevoie de un Coin Case în care să fie purtate.

en: Here, have one of ours. Every new player gets one.
text: Ține, ia unul de-al nostru. Fiecare jucător nou primește unul.

en: We sell coins for the machines: 50 for $1,000. Would you like some?
text: Vindem monede pentru aparate: 50 pentru $1,000. Vrei?

en: Your Coin Case is full already!
text: Coin Case-ul tău e deja plin!

en: I'm sorry, you don't have enough money.
text: Îmi pare rău, nu ai destui bani.
